I have some much to say about #BlackLivesMatter being this exploitive. But I’ll say this for now:
Patrisse Cullors needs to be prosecuted.

We need to discuss more about professionalized activists who have profited off the murders of Black men. Especially in the #BlackLivesMatter organization. Which no one should ever donate to again.
Patrisse Cullors is a con artist and a fraud. She should be in prison.
